snippet.title: Ereban Shadow Legacy - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Will you become the shadow… or fight against it?

Ereban Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth game where you play as Ayana, the last of a forgotten race.

Use shadow powers and advanced technology to infiltrate, survive, and uncover the truth behind a dying world.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671360/Ereban_Shadow_Legacy/

🌑 About the Game

🌘 Shadow Abilities
• Merge with shadows to move, climb, and strike
• Use stealth to avoid or eliminate enemies

🧠 Player Choice
• Decide how to approach each encounter
• Your actions shape the outcome of the story

⚙️ Powers and Technology
• Unlock lethal and non-lethal abilities
• Combine gadgets and agility for infiltration

🌍 Explore a Dying World
• Travel through ruins, cities, and ancient temples
• Discover the fate of your lost civilization

🏢 A Hidden Conspiracy
• Investigate the powerful Helios corporation
• Uncover secrets behind a global energy crisis

🎮 Dynamic Stealth Gameplay
• Fluid movement and fast decision-making
• Multiple paths and playstyles in every level
